notes: Hybrid linear-attention LLM (Kimi Delta Attention, arXiv:2510.26692). 48B total / ~3B active, 98.3GB/20 shards, released ~Nov 2025. Moonshot's reference vLLM cmd uses --tensor-parallel-size 4 (≈4 GPUs), so NOT the single-GPU model first assumed — still far lighter than K3. KDA cuts KV-cache ~75% and lifts long-context decode throughput (vendor-reported; verify). A GGUF quant (bartowski/moonshotai_Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF) can run on the llama.cpp runner instead.
